name: znetwork_dplay_create_session_from_status_fields
description: zNetwork_DPlay::CreateSessionFromStatusFields builds a DirectPlay session descriptor from recovered status fields and opens it as a hosted session.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The DirectPlay Open and Close calls are verified through the native fake IDirectPlay4 vtable rather than a live DirectPlay provider.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48a410 validates copying statusFields->sessionNameBuf into g_zNetwork_SessionNameCache, allocating and zeroing a 0x58-byte zNetworkDPlaySessionDescCache, setting desc size 0x50 and flags 0x44, copying the app GUID from g_zNetwork_AppGuid, transferring maxPlayers and custom status fields, duplicating the cached session name, and calling IDirectPlay4::Open slot 0x60 with flags 2.

BN validates returning 0 for DPERR_USERCANCEL, forwarding other negative HRESULTs to zNetwork_DPlay::ReportError with znet_dplay.cpp line 0x11e, closing DirectPlay and returning 0 when QueryCapsAndConfigureSendMode fails, and replacing g_zNetwork_CurrentSessionDescCache on success.
The native smoke verifies descriptor construction, Open arguments, status/name/GUID fields, previous-cache replacement, user-cancel return, and QueryCaps rejection close behavior.
